about: Moonlight fleet limits: the most each instance other than luna spends on strategies that trade the same thin books luna does. Each instance fetches this once a day and LOWERS its own live caps to these numbers (never raises). Keys are Moonlight setting keys in dollars; per-book keys apply to the live book only. Edit, commit, then run scripts/fleet-limits.ts in the Moonlight repo to check it. Docs: docs/FLEET-LIMITS.md.
